source: NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events v5.0, November 2017

fever.definition: A disorder characterized by elevation of the body temperature above the normal range.

nausea.definition: A disorder characterized by a queasy sensation and/or the urge to vomit.

1.description: Loss of appetite without alteration in eating habits

2.description: Oral intake decreased without significant weight loss, dehydration or malnutrition

3.description: Inadequate oral caloric or fluid intake; tube feeding, TPN, or hospitalization indicated

vomiting.definition: A disorder characterized by the reflexive act of ejecting the contents of the stomach through the mouth.

3.description: ≥6 episodes (separated by 5 min) in 24 hrs; tube feeding, TPN, or hospitalization indicated

diarrhea.definition: A disorder characterized by frequent and watery bowel movements.

1.description: Increase of <4 stools per day over baseline; mild increase in ostomy output compared to baseline

2.description: Increase of 4-6 stools per day over baseline; moderate increase in ostomy output; limiting instrumental ADL

3.description: Increase of ≥7 stools per day over baseline; hospitalization indicated; severe increase in ostomy output; limiting self-care ADL

constipation.definition: A disorder characterized by irregular and infrequent or difficult evacuation of the bowels.

1.description: Occasional or intermittent symptoms; occasional use of stool softeners, laxatives, dietary modification, or enema

2.description: Persistent symptoms with regular use of laxatives or enemas; limiting instrumental ADL

3.description: Obstipation with manual evacuation indicated; limiting self care ADL

4.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention indicated (e.g. operative intervention)

fatigue.definition: A disorder characterized by a state of generalized weakness with a pronounced inability to summon sufficient energy to accomplish daily activities.

2.description: Fatigue not relieved by rest; limiting instrumental ADL

3.description: Fatigue not relieved by rest; limiting self care ADL

pain.definition: A disorder characterized by the sensation of marked discomfort, distress, or agony.

2.description: Moderate pain; NRS 4-6; limiting instrumental ADL

3.description: Severe pain; NRS 7-9; limiting self care ADL

4.description: Disabling pain; NRS 10; unable to perform basic self-care

dyspnea.definition: A disorder characterized by an uncomfortable sensation of difficulty breathing.

1.description: Shortness of breath with moderate exertion

2.description: Shortness of breath with minimal exertion; limiting instrumental ADL

3.description: Shortness of breath at rest; limiting self care ADL

4.description: Life-threatening respiratory compromise; urgent intervention indicated (e.g. tracheotomy or intubation)

mucositis.definition: A disorder characterized by inflammation of the oral mucosal lining due to cytotoxic effects of treatment.

1.description: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated

2.description: Moderate pain or ulcer that does not interfere with oral intake; modified diet indicated

3.description: Severe pain; interfering with oral intake

peripheral_neuropathy.definition: A disorder characterized by functional disturbances of the peripheral nervous system.

1.description: Asymptomatic; loss of deep tendon reflexes or paresthesia

3.description: Severe symptoms; limiting self care ADL

bleeding.definition: A disorder characterized by bleeding from mucosal surfaces or skin, or internal bleeding.

2.description: Moderate bleeding; medical intervention or minor cauterization indicated

3.description: Transfusion indicated; radiologic, endoscopic, or operative intervention indicated
